hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the RHEV Manager (RHEV-M) API endpoint.

port.description: TCP port to connect to RHEV-M API (usually 8080 for HTTP or 443 for HTTPS).

login.description: Username for RHEV-M API authentication (e.g., admin@internal or admin@domain.com).

passwd_file.description: Path to a file containing the password for the RHEV-M user (recommended for security).

api_path.description: API path suffix — usually `/api` for RHEV-M 3.x/4.x.

secure.description: Whether to use HTTPS (secure) or HTTP (insecure). Should always be enabled in production.

ssl_verify.description: Whether to validate the RHEV-M server’s SSL certificate (disable only for self-signed in controlled environments).
